Hello Ramesh ji, namaste. Main Sunita bo.text: Sunita says she wants to talk about painting her flat.
Hello Ramesh ji, namaste. Main Sunita bo.quote: Hello Ramesh ji, namaste. Main Sunita bol rahi hoon, apne flat ki painting ke liye baat karni thi.

Ji namaste madam, boliye. Kaunsa flat ha.text: Ramesh asks which flat it is and how big it is.
Ji namaste madam, boliye. Kaunsa flat ha.quote: Ji namaste madam, boliye. Kaunsa flat hai, kitna bada hai?

2BHK hai, Sector 62 Noida mein. Do bedro.text: Sunita says the flat is a 2BHK in Sector 62, Noida, and the painting work includes both bedrooms, the hall, the kitchen, and the ceilings of both bathrooms.
2BHK hai, Sector 62 Noida mein. Do bedro.value: 2BHK flat in Sector 62, Noida; paint two bedrooms, hall, kitchen, and both bathroom ceilings
2BHK hai, Sector 62 Noida mein. Do bedro.quote: 2BHK hai, Sector 62 Noida mein. Do bedroom, hall, kitchen, aur dono bathroom ki ceiling karni hai.

Theek hai madam. Sirf andar ka kaam hai.text: Ramesh asks whether the job is only interior work or also the balcony and exterior.
Theek hai madam. Sirf andar ka kaam hai.quote: Theek hai madam. Sirf andar ka kaam hai ya balcony aur bahar ka bhi?

Sirf andar ka. Do coat lagane hain, jaha.text: Sunita says the job is only interior work.
Sunita says the painting needs two coats.
Sirf andar ka. Do coat lagane hain, jaha.quote: Do coat lagane hain, jahan zaroorat ho wahan putty, aur paint Asian Paints ka Royale chahiye.

Sirf andar ka. Do coat lagane hain, jaha.text: Sunita says putty should be used where needed.
Sirf andar ka. Do coat lagane hain, jaha.quote: Do coat lagane hain, jahan zaroorat ho wahan putty, aur paint Asian Paints ka Royale chahiye.

Sirf andar ka. Do coat lagane hain, jaha.text: Sunita says the paint should be Asian Paints Royale.
Sirf andar ka. Do coat lagane hain, jaha.quote: Do coat lagane hain, jahan zaroorat ho wahan putty, aur paint Asian Paints ka Royale chahiye.

Ho jayega madam. Poora 2BHK andar se, do.text: Ramesh accepts the interior-only painting work for the whole 2BHK with two coats, putty where needed, and Asian Paints Royale paint.
Ho jayega madam. Poora 2BHK andar se, do.value: interior only; whole 2BHK; two coats; putty where needed; Asian Paints Royale
Ho jayega madam. Poora 2BHK andar se, do.quote: Ho jayega madam. Poora 2BHK andar se, do coat, putty ke saath, Royale paint. Pakka.

Haan bilkul yahi. Ab paisa batao, kitna.text: Sunita confirms the agreed work is exactly the same as discussed: the 2BHK flat in Sector 62, Noida, with interior painting of two bedrooms, hall, kitchen, and both bathroom ceilings, with two coats, putty where needed, and Asian Paints Royale.
Haan bilkul yahi. Ab paisa batao, kitna.value: 2BHK flat in Sector 62, Noida; paint two bedrooms, hall, kitchen, and both bathroom ceilings; interior only; two coats; putty where needed; Asian Paints Royale
Haan bilkul yahi. Ab paisa batao, kitna.quote: Haan bilkul yahi. Ab paisa batao, kitna loge?

Haan bilkul yahi. Ab paisa batao, kitna.text: Sunita asks the worker to quote the price for the job.
Haan bilkul yahi. Ab paisa batao, kitna.quote: Haan bilkul yahi. Ab paisa batao, kitna loge?

Madam material aur labour mila ke 45 haz.text: Ramesh says material and labour together will cost 45,000 rupees.
Madam material aur labour mila ke 45 haz.quote: Madam material aur labour mila ke 45 hazaar lagega.

45 toh bahut zyada hai bhaiya. 40 mein k.text: Sunita offers 40,000 rupees for the job.
45 toh bahut zyada hai bhaiya. 40 mein k.quote: 45 toh bahut zyada hai bhaiya. 40 mein kar do.

Madam Royale mehenga paint hai. Chalo 42.text: Ramesh offers 42,000 rupees as the final total price.
Madam Royale mehenga paint hai. Chalo 42.quote: Madam Royale mehenga paint hai. Chalo 42 hazaar final, isse kam nahi hoga.

Theek hai, 42 hazaar done. Material tumh.text: The hirer accepts the worker's 42,000 rupees total price.
Theek hai, 42 hazaar done. Material tumh.quote: Theek hai, 42 hazaar done. Material tumhara hi rahega na?

Theek hai, 42 hazaar done. Material tumh.text: The hirer says the material will be the worker's own.
Theek hai, 42 hazaar done. Material tumh.quote: Theek hai, 42 hazaar done. Material tumhara hi rahega na?

Haan ji, material sab mera. Bas kaam shu.text: The worker says the material will be his.
The worker says he needs some advance before starting the work to buy paint.
Haan ji, material sab mera. Bas kaam shu.quote: Bas kaam shuru karne se pehle thoda advance chahiye, paint khareedna padega.

Kitna advance?.text: Sunita asks how much advance is needed.

15 hazaar de dijiye advance..text: Ramesh asks for 15,000 rupees as advance before the work starts.

15 nahi, 10 hazaar deti hoon, kal UPI se.text: Sunita offers 10,000 rupees as advance, instead of 15,000, to be paid tomorrow by UPI.
15 nahi, 10 hazaar deti hoon, kal UPI se.quote: 15 nahi, 10 hazaar deti hoon, kal UPI se.

Chaliye theek hai, das hazaar advance ka.text: The worker accepts the hirer's 10,000 rupees advance and asks for it to be sent tomorrow.
Chaliye theek hai, das hazaar advance ka.quote: Chaliye theek hai, das hazaar advance kal bhej dijiye.

Aur baaki paisa kab dena hai?.text: The hirer asks when the remaining money is to be paid.
Aur baaki paisa kab dena hai?.quote: Aur baaki paisa kab dena hai?

Woh dekh lenge madam, koi tension nahi..text: The worker accepts the 10,000 rupee advance proposed by the hirer.
Woh dekh lenge madam, koi tension nahi..quote: Chaliye theek hai, das hazaar advance kal bhej dijiye.

Woh dekh lenge madam, koi tension nahi..text: The worker asks when the work should start.
Woh dekh lenge madam, koi tension nahi..quote: Aap yeh batao kaam kab se shuru karna hai?

Somwar se shuru kar do, 23 November se..text: Sunita says the work should start Monday, 23 November.
Somwar se shuru kar do, 23 November se..quote: Somwar se shuru kar do, 23 November se.

Ji, 23 November somwar se shuru. Saat di.text: The worker says the job will start on 23 November 2026 and finish by 30 November 2026.
Ji, 23 November somwar se shuru. Saat di.quote: Ji, 23 November somwar se shuru. Saat din ka kaam hai, 30 November tak khatam kar dunga.

Pakka 30 tak? Mere ghar mehmaan aa rahe.text: The hirer asks whether the worker will definitely finish by the 30th, and mentions guests coming on 2 December.
Pakka 30 tak? Mere ghar mehmaan aa rahe.quote: Pakka 30 tak? Mere ghar mehmaan aa rahe hain 2 December ko.

Pakka madam, 30 November tak poora ho ja.text: Worker accepts the agreed finish date as 30 November.
Pakka madam, 30 November tak poora ho ja.quote: Pakka madam, 30 November tak poora ho jayega.

Toh madam total 43 hazaar hua na, usme s.text: The worker says the total is 43,000 rupees.
Toh madam total 43 hazaar hua na, usme s.quote: Toh madam total 43 hazaar hua na, usme se 10 advance kal.

Toh madam total 43 hazaar hua na, usme s.text: The worker says 10,000 rupees will be given as advance tomorrow.
Toh madam total 43 hazaar hua na, usme s.quote: Toh madam total 43 hazaar hua na, usme se 10 advance kal.

Haan theek hai. Aur dekho, furniture dha.text: Sunita accepts that the worker will cover the furniture and handle cleaning too.
Sunita adds that the worker should cover the furniture and do the cleaning.
Haan theek hai. Aur dekho, furniture dha.quote: Aur dekho, furniture dhak ke kaam karna, safai bhi tumhari.

Bilkul madam, sab cover kar denge, safai.text: The worker says they will cover everything and leave after cleaning, accepting the furniture and cleaning requirement.
Bilkul madam, sab cover kar denge, safai.quote: Bilkul madam, sab cover kar denge, safai karke hi jayenge.

Bilkul madam, sab cover kar denge, safai.text: The worker says they will cover everything and leave after cleaning.
Bilkul madam, sab cover kar denge, safai.quote: Bilkul madam, sab cover kar denge, safai karke hi jayenge.

Chalo theek hai phir, kal advance bhej d.text: Sunita says she will send the advance tomorrow.
Chalo theek hai phir, kal advance bhej d.quote: Chalo theek hai phir, kal advance bhej deti hoon. Ab rakhti hoon.

Ji madam, dhanyavaad. Somwar ko subah 9.text: The worker says he will come at 9 a.m. on Monday.
Ji madam, dhanyavaad. Somwar ko subah 9.quote: Ji madam, dhanyavaad. Somwar ko subah 9 baje aa jaunga.

Theek hai, somwar ko milte hain. Namaste.text: The hirer says 'theek hai' but only for meeting on Monday, not for any deal term.
Theek hai, somwar ko milte hain. Namaste.quote: Theek hai, somwar ko milte hain. Namaste.
